# local 0002: Compiler crash for initializers that are computed by code and have a conditional operator or, on mcs51, need a spill location

- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17193
- Recommended action: Confirm under Decision that only initializers that mcs51 cannot compile get error 2, then apply the patch.
- Patch: [local-0002.patch](../../patches/local-0002.patch), commit [`f056b27b2`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/f056b27b240aed72b15e797e167b5bd07470a21a). Apply after `bugs-3971.patch`.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

With the small and medium models, `sdcc -mmcs51 -c` fails for each of these files. Each line is
one file.

```c
extern char x, y; unsigned long long a = (unsigned long long)(unsigned)&x + (unsigned)&y; // a.c
char x[4]; int c = &x[1] && &x[2];                                                        // b.c
char x, y; int a = (&x == &y) ? 1 : 2;                                                    // c.c
```

For `a.c` the compiler reports error 9 at `wassert (currFunc)` in `canOverlayLocals` of
`src/SDCCmem.c` and ends with SIGSEGV. For `b.c` it writes a bit named `_(null)_sloc0_1_0`, which
the assembler rejects. For `c.c` it ends with SIGSEGV in `visit` of `src/SDCClrange.c`. For
`static int a = (&x == &y) ? 1 : 2;` in a function, it ends with SIGSEGV for mcs51, stm8, and
z80. With the large model, and for stm8 and z80, the three files get error 2, "Initializer
element is not a constant expression". The files were compiled on r17176 and on r17192 with the
earlier patches of this report, and the static variable on the latter.

## Cause

`emitRegularMap` in `src/SDCCglue.c` generates code that computes the initializers of global
variables that are not initialized from data, such as those of the mcs51 small and medium models.
`currFunc` is NULL for this code. `createStackSpil` in `src/mcs51/ralloc.c` allocates a spill
location as a local variable of `currFunc`. The sum in `a.c` needs 8 bytes, and the `&&` in `b.c`
needs a bit. `allocLocal` formats `currFunc->name` into the name, `canOverlayLocals` dereferences
`currFunc`, and with `--stack-auto` `createStackSpil` adds to `currFunc->stack`.

`visit` advances to `ic->next` in its default case and reads the result of that iCode without a
check for NULL. The code of a function ends with `ENDFUNCTION`. Initializer code ends with its
last assignment, where the temporary of a conditional operator is still alive.

## Fix

`visit` stops at the end of the code, and the compiler then generates the code of conditional
initializers. For the code of static variables, `eBBlockFromiCode` in `src/SDCCopt.c` skips its
check for a missing return statement, which otherwise gives warning 59 in functions that return a
value. `createStackSpil` reports error 2 and exits when `currFunc` is NULL.

## Decision

With the small and medium models, the compiler accepts some initializers that are not constant
expressions in ISO C, such as `char p = ar[1];` and `char *p = &ar[vi];`, and code at startup
computes them. In ucsim the variables had the right values, and programs can depend on that. With
the patch they compile as before, and whether an initializer gets error 2 depends on the mcs51
register allocator. `b.c` gets it with the small model and compiles with `--stack-auto`. The
alternative is error 2 from the front end for every initializer that is not a constant
expression, with which the compiler rejects the two declarations above as well. Spill locations
for code outside of functions would make the error unnecessary and were not tried.

## Verification

The patch adds `initializer-by-code.c` to `support/regression/tests` and to
`support/valdiag/tests`. The two tests have global variables that the small and medium models
initialize by code, static variables with a conditional initializer, and three initializers that
get error 2 on mcs51. On r17192 with the earlier patches of this report, the regression test does
not compile for mcs51, stm8, and ucz80, and the diagnostics test fails for mcs51, z80, and stm8.
With the patch both pass. The diagnostics test has `const char *p10 = "abc" + 1;`, the construct
of bug #3971, so it needs the patch for that bug on mcs51-large, stm8, and z80. It was not run
without that patch.

197 one-line declarations were compiled with and without the patch for mcs51 with five sets of
options, for stm8, and for z80. The result changes for 19, each from a crash or from output that
does not assemble or link, and the assembly of the declarations that both compilers accept is
identical. The patch does not change the assembly of the other regression tests for mcs51-small,
mcs51-medium, and mcs51-large. With the series of this report up to the patch for local 0004
applied to r17192, the regression suite has 0 failures for host, stm8, ucz80, and mcs51 with the
small, medium, large, and huge models and with `--stack-auto` for the small and large models. The
diagnostics suite has 0 failures for mcs51, mcs51-large, mcs51-stack-auto, z80, and stm8.

## Related

- Bug #3895 reports the assertion of `a.c` for an array with an initializer, which compiles on
  r17176.
- The patch does not change static variables of functions whose initializer needs a spill
  location on mcs51. Such a location can get the name of a spill location of the function, and
  the assembler then reports a multiple definition.
- `createStackSpil` in `src/ds390/ralloc.c` and in `src/hc08/ralloc.c` also adds to
  `currFunc->stack`. These ports were not built.
